unit.en: Directorate of Special Forces (DSF), London — headquarters of United Kingdom Special Forces

description.fr: Officier général à deux étoiles qui commande les United Kingdom Special Forces : 22 SAS, SBS, SRR, 18 (UKSF) Signal Regiment, SFSG et Joint Special Forces Aviation Wing. Il conseille le ministère et l'état-major sur l'emploi des forces spéciales et rend compte directement au niveau stratégique. Le ministère de la Défense ne commente pas les opérations des UKSF ; les informations publiques restent très limitées.
description.en: Two-star officer commanding United Kingdom Special Forces: 22 SAS, SBS, SRR, 18 (UKSF) Signal Regiment, SFSG and the Joint Special Forces Aviation Wing. He advises ministers and the Defence staff on special forces employment and reports at strategic level. The Ministry of Defence does not comment on UKSF operations, so public information is very limited.

He works in four-man patrols for reconnaissance, direct action and counter-terrorism. He keeps up patrol skills: communications, medical, languages, demolitions. No official source describes the job in detail.

Exact organisation and chain of command are poorly documented in public.

He or she carries out covert surveillance and intelligence collection for special operations. The regiment was formed in 2005, built largely on 14 Intelligence Company, to meet the special reconnaissance need identified by the 2002 Strategic Defence Review.

He disposes of unexploded ordnance found below the high-water mark, on vessels and at coastal properties, often wartime relics; UK clearance divers are tasked about once a day on average.
